prompt: Spec a data-table page for an admin users list with sort, row select, and bulk actions. Desktop-first, usable on mobile-web.
response_excerpt: Real <table> with <th scope> and aria-sort; sticky header (position: sticky). Body 14px/0.875rem, line-height 1.4; page title clamp(1.5rem, 1.3rem + 1vw, 2rem). 12-col grid, 24px gutters, cell padding 12px/16px (space tokens). States: default, hover, :focus-visible, loading skeleton, empty (clear-filters link), error banner with retry, disabled bulk bar until selection. Keyboard: arrow-key cell nav, Space selects a row, row menu opens on Enter and closes on ESC with focus restored; skip link. Selection announced via aria-live; status badges are text + icon + color (>=4.5:1; badges 3:1). Below 768px the table reflows to stacked cards; verified no horizontal scroll at 320px. Server-paginated, URL-encoded sort/filter so views are shareable.
expected_rationale: Strong and shippable: real table semantics with aria-sort, a full state set, complete keyboard operability with focus restore, non-color status cues at stated contrast, a genuine 320px card reflow, and shareable URL-encoded state. Density is exploited where it helps. It lands at 4/5 rather than 5/5 because brand/context fit is generic (no owned visual character) and it does not yet name the dark-theme/forced-colors tokens, localization, or a measured Core Web Vitals/INP budget under interaction.
improvement_suggestions: Add resilience for 5/5: dark-theme + forced-colors token values, localization of column headers, and a measured INP budget for sort/select under large datasets (virtualization).
Give the table one owned visual asset (a considered density preset or a signature empty state) so it is not template-generic.
